titel: A pinch of salt makes grapefruit sweeter
kurz: Two segments of grapefruit, one with a tiny pinch of salt: the salted one tastes less bitter and sweeter.
bild_im_kopf: Like a curtain drawn in front of a glaring lamp: suddenly you can see the other colours in the room.
beobachtung: The salted segment hardly tastes salty, but it is less bitter and the sweetness comes forward.
erklaerung: Salt dampens the perception of bitter compounds. Because the bitterness recedes, you taste the sweetness more strongly, although no sugar has been added.
schritte: Sprinkle a very little salt on one, just visible.
Taste the unsalted one first, drink some water, then the salted one.
Compare: how bitter, how sweet, how salty?
material: a glass of water to rinse
